channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: ‘Maximum use’: Iran boosts military strength during ceasefire with US
item.description: IRGC spokesman Hossein Mohebbi said last month that Iran's missile production rate increased during the ceasefire.

item.title: Rubio: Progress made to reopen Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Marco Rubio, US Secretary of State, said there has been progress in negotiations to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Gaza holds mass funeral for 112 people killed in Israel’s 2023 Sabra attack
item.description: Thousands join to bury remains after they were recovered from rubble of homes destroyed during Israel’s genocidal war.

item.title: War on Iran: Trump says Iran has one ‘last chance’
item.description: US President Donald Trump says Iran has ‘one last chance’ to make a deal, but Tehran is in no hurry to take it.

item.title: Mass funeral in Gaza for 112 Palestinians killed in 2023 Israeli strike
item.description: The bodies - belonging to members of two extended families - have only recently been recovered from under rubble in Gaza City.

item.title: Did Iran hack water systems in seven US states?
item.description: While US President Donald Trump has said Iran is not to blame, cyber experts tell the BBC it likely the attack was at the hands of the Iran.
